description: Extract the ATS keywords and requirements in a job posting, with each term's category, importance and must-have flag. Shows must-have versus nice-to-have requirements so the resume can reflect the posting's own language. It does not change the user's resume or settings. Requires a connected GetMattered account and uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to read a posting from a link; use getmattered_get_matches with job_url. Next: getmattered_score_resume or getmattered_optimize_resume with the same job description.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description
